cards.answer: Aatrox is a fighter who deals physical damage with repeated sword strikes and heals while damaging enemy champions. His broad learning focus is attack damage and sustained fighting.
cards.counterplay: Avoid his sword strikes and limit the damage he can deal to your team.

cards.answer: Periodically, Aatrox's next basic attack deals bonus magic damage based on the target's maximum health and heals him for the bonus damage dealt.
cards.counterplay: Avoid giving him a free empowered attack when trading.

citations.quote: Periodically, Aatrox's next basic attack deals bonus magic damage and heals him, based on the target's max health.
Innate: Periodically, Aatrox's next basic attack deals bonus magic damage based on the target's maximum health, healing him for the damage dealt.

passive_visual.description: Aatrox thrusts his sword forward for the empowered attack.

cards.priority_reason: The empowered attack adds damage and healing to short trades.
uncertainties: UNAPPROVED draft.
The thrust cue is a tentative proposal from the supplied official-clip frames, not current-client visual verification; the text excerpts do not describe the thrust.
Healing uses bonus damage actually dealt and is reduced against minions.
Eligible attacks and ability hits reduce passive cooldown; Q sweetspots reduce it further.
Structures and wards do not trigger empowerment, and dodged, blocked or missed attacks do not apply its bonus damage.
Readiness during an ordinary attack's windup and spell-shield interactions have additional timing exceptions.

cards.answer: Aatrox can make up to three sword strikes that deal physical damage in different areas, with damage increasing on successive casts. Each strike has a sweetspot that deals extra damage and briefly knocks enemies up.
cards.counterplay: Dodge the strike areas, especially their sweetspots. Watch for further swings after the first strike.

citations.quote: Aatrox slams his greatsword down, dealing physical damage. He can swing three times, each with a different area of effect.
The area varies and the damage increases per cast.

facts.claim: Aatrox can make up to three sword strikes that deal physical damage in different areas, with damage increasing on successive casts.

citations.quote: Enemies within each area's Sweetspot receive increased damage and are briefly knocked up.

facts.claim: Each strike has a sweetspot that deals extra damage and briefly knocks enemies up.

cards.priority_reason: Repeated sweetspot hits combine increased damage with crowd control.
uncertainties: UNAPPROVED draft.
Sweetspots have specific overlap and center-based hitbox requirements.
The first two sweetspots are at the far edge; the third is inside the circular strike.
Recasts have a limited window, and E can reposition the strike during its cast.

cards.answer: Aatrox fires a directional chain that deals physical damage and slows the first enemy hit. A champion or large monster hit must leave the tether area quickly or be pulled toward its center and take damage again.
cards.counterplay: Dodge the chain. If it hits you, leave the tether area promptly to avoid the pull and second damage.

citations.quote: Active: Aatrox sends a chain in the target direction that deals physical damage and slows the first enemy hit.

facts.claim: Aatrox fires a directional chain that deals physical damage and slows the first enemy hit.

citations.quote: Champions and large monsters have to leave the impact area quickly or they will be dragged to the center and take the damage again.
If the tether is not broken by the end of its duration, the target is dealt the same physical damage again and pulled to the center of the area.

facts.claim: A champion or large monster hit must leave the tether area quickly or be pulled toward its center and take damage again.

cards.priority_reason: The slow and delayed pull can restrict escape and set up further strikes.
uncertainties: UNAPPROVED draft.
The tether reveals affected champions and large monsters.
A spell shield blocks initial application but not an already-applied chain's aftereffects.
Area orientation and the precise pull location depend on Aatrox's position.

cards.answer: Aatrox passively heals for a portion of the non-persistent damage he deals to enemy champions, after damage reduction. Activating this ability dashes him in the chosen direction.
cards.counterplay: Account for his dash when avoiding sword strikes. Limit the damage he lands on champions to limit his healing.

citations.quote: Passively, Aatrox heals when damaging enemy champions.
Passive: Aatrox heals for 16% (+ 1.3% per 100 bonus health) of non- persistent post-mitigation damage he deals against enemy champions.

facts.claim: Aatrox passively heals for a portion of the non-persistent damage he deals to enemy champions, after damage reduction.

facts.claim: Activating this ability dashes him in the chosen direction.

cards.priority_reason: The dash changes his positioning, while passive healing supports continued fighting.
uncertainties: UNAPPROVED draft.
The dash resets his basic attack timer and can overlap other abilities without cancelling them.
Terrain can extend the dash within limits; it does not cross every wall.
The model-darkening note describes a remnant visual, not a current attack damage buff.

cards.answer: Aatrox temporarily transforms, gaining attack damage, movement speed and increased self-healing. Activation fears nearby enemy minions. Champion takedowns extend the form's duration.
cards.counterplay: Create distance during his empowered form and avoid giving him takedowns that prolong it.

citations.quote: Aatrox unleashes his demonic form, fearing nearby enemy minions and gaining attack damage, increased healing, and Move Speed.
Active: Aatrox unleashes his true form for a period, gaining a burst of move speed. During this time, Aatrox has increased attack damage, self-healing, and is ghosted.
